summary: Remote DJ control consolidation: administrator Disable/Enable Remote PTT moves into the Remote PTT button and Kick into the Connect button; the dedicated emergency row is removed. Engine-owned PTT generations reject stale ON after Disable/Enable while an authenticated current-session OFF still silences recovery safely. Older pages fail closed until reloaded. No migration, companion, static, unit, package, nginx or protected-runtime change. Restart Gunicorn, then the audio engine.
